title: Battle of Ashar Creek
text: The Battle of Ashar Creek was a prolonged naval engagement in Spring of 1775 between the Zand Dynasty of Iran, aided by the Banu Ka'b and Shaykh of Bushehr, against the Ottoman Mamluk-held Iraq and their British aides. A chain boom had been constructed over the Shatt al-Arab to inhibit a naval blockade of Basra. The Persians made many attempts both to probe and break through, and were held up for half a month until the British chain was broken and the Persians were subsequently able to extend their blockade over the entire city.
